name: Stranded in Space
source:
Stranded in Space is an erotic sci-fi Visual Novel about a man who wakes up on a spaceship filled only with women. Meet a huge cast of beautiful girls, unravel the connected mysteries, and have a ton of sex within a story acclaimed for its comedy and writing.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2283780/Stranded_in_Space/]Steam[/url]]
